fullName.description:
Apple only discloses the user's name on their very first
authorization for the app. Send it when present; when
omitted the account keeps the name already on file.

inviteToken.description:
Optional invite token; when valid the account joins the
invite's group and may be provisioned even if its email
isn't on the allow-list.

rawNonce.description:
The unhashed nonce the app bound the token to this server
with. The app requests the token with
`nonce = sha256hex("famlin-apple-signin|<server host>|<rawNonce>")`,
where `<server host>` is the lowercase `host[:port]` it
talks to (default ports dropped). A token carrying a nonce
is rejected (401) unless it matches this server's host or
its configured public URL — that stops a token sent to one
Famlin server from being replayed on another. Tokens without
a nonce (older app builds) are still accepted.
